verdict.language_detail: MATLAB script for oceanographic quad-panel SSH standard deviation plots
verdict.provenance_detail: Ocean plotting and analysis script from Swierczek4/ocean_plotting_and_analysis_accessories
verdict.purpose: Generates 2x2 subplot figures comparing SSH (sea surface height) standard deviation fields from B-SOSE and MITgcm+BLING model runs at different resolutions (1/3, 1/6, 1/12 degree) for various seasonal periods (JJA, JAS, JJASON, JASOND, DN, JD, DJF, JFM, JFMAMJ) and saves them as PNG files.
